reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset & Brown read Jeremiah's childless verdict as dynastic exclusion from David's throne rather than a literal absence of offspring.

sides.snippet: The sons of Jeconiah, the captive: Shealtiel his son
sides.verseText: The sons of Jeconiah, the captive: Shealtiel his son,

sides.snippet: Write you this man childless, a man who shall not prosper in his days
sides.verseText: Thus says Yahweh, Write you this man childless, a man who shall not prosper in his days; for no more shall a man of his seed prosper, sitting on the throne of David, and ruling in Judah.
